# Use marketing-flyer

<!-- Generated by build_pack_guides.py from pack.json and the skills' own files. Edit those, not this. -->

Generate a print-ready, on-brand marketing flyer — event, launch, open day, offer, hiring — as one self-contained HTML file (Letter, A4, A5, or square and story sizes for social) that saves to PDF, built from the user's own logo, colours, fonts and content, with one call to action, a short headline, contrast checked, and no invented dates, prices or contact details.

**Reach for it when** the user wants a flyer, poster, one-pager, handout, leaflet or event announcement "in our branding", or says "make a flyer for…".

## Install it

```bash
npx skilldrop-cli install marketing-flyer                 # Claude Code, your user folder
npx skilldrop-cli install marketing-flyer --project       # Claude Code, this repo
npx skilldrop-cli install marketing-flyer --ide cursor    # or kiro, codex, antigravity, copilot
```

It is part of the Design pack: [`--pack design`](../packs/use-the-design-pack.md) installs it with its neighbours.

It ships scripts, so it needs Python 3 (standard library only, nothing to install). What they may touch is declared in [its manifest](../../../packs/design/skills/marketing-flyer/manifest.json).

## Ask for it

Say it the way you would to a colleague. Requests like these route to it:

- "Make a flyer for our open day in our brand colours"
- "Design a one-page handout announcing the new clinic"
- "I need a poster for the charity run, with our logo"
- "Create an Instagram-sized announcement image that matches our flyer"

Requests like these belong to a different skill, so it shouldn't answer them:

- "Build the board deck as a pptx"
- "Write the press release for the launch"
- "Set up our brand colours and fonts so we can reuse them"

If another skill answers instead, ask for this one by name: "use marketing-flyer".

## Check what you get

A good result:

- **It is in the user's brand:** their logo, their colours as hex codes, their fonts. Default colours only when the user has no brand material, and then said out loud.
- **Every fact comes from the user.** Dates, times, places, prices and contact details are copied, not composed.
- **One call to action,** worded as a verb, with the address or number that makes it actionable.
- **A headline of ten words or fewer, at most four points.** Anything longer belongs on the linked page.
- **Text is readable everywhere:** body text at least 4.5:1 against the background, and the script's band and call-to-action figures reported.
- **The file is the whole flyer.** Images are embedded, with no links to local files that break when it's emailed.

## Use something else when

- A slide deck; use `deck-builder`
- A multi-page brochure or a report, which this doesn't lay out
- Designing a brand from scratch; capture an existing one with `brand-kit`
